Decision aid — delete after the direction is picked

Which one replaces teal?

The shipped accent (teal #12666e/#68b8c0 + terracotta live) read as "navy blue and gold." All four below share one live-state colour — a clean sky blue, deliberately far from anything gold-adjacent — and vary only the primary "outcome" accent, so the comparison isolates the one thing that needs to change. Each is measured AA-clear on both grounds, both as text and as a fill with its paired ink colour.

A — Coral & Sky

Warm and immediate — a Dubai-sunset energy that still reads confident, not childish. The coolest-feeling of the four against a warm ground.
